VRChat Social Ecosystem Proposal

Hello VRChat Team,

I would like to suggest expanding VRChat’s social system to make the platform more connected and engaging.

A built-in private messaging system would allow users to communicate outside instances through DMs, message requests, group chats, notifications, and privacy controls. This would reduce the need to move basic conversations to external platforms.

Users could also have complete social profiles containing a bio, posts, stories, followers, following, communities, favorite worlds, creations, and achievements. A following system would allow users to follow creators, world builders, avatar creators, artists, performers, and communities without adding everyone as a friend.

Adding posts and stories would let users share screenshots, artwork, avatars, world discoveries, announcements, and events. A personalized discovery and recommendation system could then recommend worlds, creators, communities, events, and content based on user interests.

A trending section could highlight popular worlds, creators, avatars, posts, and events, giving smaller creators a chance to grow.

An integrated events system could provide event pages, RSVPs, reminders, attendee counts, and notifications.

A Recently Met feature could help users reconnect with people they encountered in worlds, while privacy settings would control who can contact or discover them.

Together, these features could create a cycle:

Create → Share → Discover → Follow → Connect → Build Communities → Attend Events → Return

VRChat already has the community and unique social environment. Adding this social infrastructure could turn it into a much larger connected virtual community and give users more reasons to return every day.

Thank you for considering this proposal.
